findings.description: Although there is no direct OS command execution in this code, the use of hardcoded IP addresses and port numbers can be a concern if this code is part of a larger application that might execute commands based on user input or configuration files.

Similar to CWE-78, this code does not directly execute OS commands, but the use of hardcoded values can lead to security issues if this code is part of a larger application that might execute commands based on user input or configuration files.
